name: Codex CLI Bridge
description: Send PaperTodo todos and paper content directly to the local Codex CLI.

settings.name: Enable on startup
settings.description: Automatically create a hidden Codex CLI plugin paper to keep the global todo and top-bar actions available.

settings.name: Run in background
settings.description: Hide the terminal window and run Codex silently. Off by default; when off, Codex always opens in the foreground.

settings.name: Model
settings.description: Model ID passed to Codex CLI. Defaults to gpt-6-astra; leave empty to keep the Codex CLI model setting.

settings.name: Reasoning
settings.description: Value passed to model_reasoning_effort. Defaults to xhigh; leave empty to keep the Codex CLI setting.

settings.name: Codex CLI command
settings.description: Uses codex from PATH by default. You can also enter codex.cmd or an absolute path.

settings.name: Default working directory
settings.description: Used when no local path is linked. Leave empty to use the user profile directory; environment variables such as %USERPROFILE% are supported.

settings.name: Edit prompt
settings.description: Open the hidden Codex CLI prompt editor.

settings.name: Enable plugin skill
settings.description: Inject the bundled PaperTodo plugin-development skill when sending a task.

settings.name: Enable PaperTodo operation skill
settings.description: Inject short instructions for operating papers, todos, and notes through MCP.

settings.name: Allow this plugin to enable MCP
settings.description: Allow automatic MCP activation when needed, including all write/delete and sensitive application-settings control permissions.

zh.description: 从 PaperTodo 待办项和纸片顶栏把内容直接发送给本机 Codex CLI。

autoStart.name: 启动后自动启用
autoStart.description: 自动创建一张默认隐藏的 Codex CLI 插件纸片，用于保持全局待办按钮和顶栏按钮可用。

backgroundExecution.name: 后台执行
backgroundExecution.description: 隐藏终端窗口并静默运行 Codex。默认关闭；关闭时 Codex 始终以前台窗口运行。

model.name: 模型
model.description: 传给 Codex CLI 的模型 ID。默认 gpt-6-astra；留空则不覆盖 Codex 自己的模型配置。

reasoningEffort.name: 推理
reasoningEffort.description: 传给 model_reasoning_effort。默认 xhigh（极高）；留空则不覆盖 Codex 自己的推理配置。

codexPath.name: Codex CLI 命令
codexPath.description: 默认使用 PATH 中的 codex。也可以填写 codex.cmd 或绝对路径。

workingDirectory.name: 默认工作目录
workingDirectory.description: 没有绑定本地路径时使用。留空则使用用户目录；支持 %USERPROFILE% 等环境变量。

editPrompt.name: 编辑提示词
editPrompt.description: 打开默认隐藏的 Codex CLI 提示词编辑纸片。

enablePluginSkill.name: 开启插件技能
enablePluginSkill.description: 发送任务时注入 PaperTodo 插件制作技能。

enableOperationSkill.name: 开启本软件操作技能
enableOperationSkill.description: 发送任务时注入通过 MCP 操作纸片、待办和笔记的简短指引。

allowMcp.name: 允许本插件开启 MCP
allowMcp.description: 任务需要 MCP 时，允许自动开启 MCP 总开关及全部写入、删除和敏感软件设置控制权限。

editPrompt.name: プロンプトを編集
editPrompt.description: 既定で非表示の Codex CLI プロンプト編集用紙片を開きます。

enablePluginSkill.name: プラグイン制作スキルを有効化
enablePluginSkill.description: タスク送信時に PaperTodo プラグイン制作スキルを追加します。

enableOperationSkill.name: PaperTodo 操作スキルを有効化
enableOperationSkill.description: MCP で紙、タスク、ノートを操作する短い指示を追加します。

allowMcp.name: このプラグインによる MCP の有効化を許可
allowMcp.description: 必要なときに MCP とすべての書き込み・削除・機密アプリ設定の変更権限を自動的に有効化できます。

editPrompt.name: 프롬프트 편집
editPrompt.description: 기본적으로 숨겨진 Codex CLI 프롬프트 편집 종이를 엽니다.

enablePluginSkill.name: 플러그인 제작 스킬 사용
enablePluginSkill.description: 작업 전송 시 PaperTodo 플러그인 제작 스킬을 추가합니다.

enableOperationSkill.name: PaperTodo 조작 스킬 사용
enableOperationSkill.description: MCP로 메모와 할 일을 조작하는 간단한 지침을 추가합니다.

allowMcp.name: 이 플러그인의 MCP 활성화 허용
allowMcp.description: 필요할 때 MCP 및 모든 쓰기·삭제·민감한 앱 설정 변경 권한을 자동으로 켤 수 있습니다.
